Traffic moves slowly towards Ogudu bus stop due to the ongoing repair of the expansion joint at Ifako.

Proceeding towards Iyana Oworo from Ifako is free.
The Stretch of the Third mainland bridge is free as expected.
Drive within the speed limit.
